author: Syzygo
body: Hello there Staff, this is Ingigo, this is my alternate account. Is it possible if it can be appealed as Ingigo is unbanned like 5 weeks ago. It would be nice if this was possible and I also want this alternate account so I can just enjoy my time on Avicus without anyone saying "Hi Ingigo" as I feel like I have to reply back everytime they do this. Thanks!
